【话本小说 · 使用说明】(本书源基于 Legado MD3 版本制作调试)

■ 这是什么
话本小说网(www.ihuaben.com)书源, 以同人/原创小说为主, 免费在线阅读。

■ 搜索说明
1. 支持书名/作者搜索(话本站内搜索 so.ihuaben.com)
2. 注意: 话本是同人/原创平台, 没有主流网文(如斗破苍穹等搜不到属正常)
3. 若开「精确搜索」, 只返回书名与关键词完全一致的结果

■ 发现页(5个榜单)
点击榜 / 评论榜 / 收藏榜 / 新书榜 / 新手村, 各100条

■ 正文阅读
1. 章节开头的角色对话已排版为「头像+名字：台词」(模拟聊天, 线性排列)
2. 已自动清除: 评论数字徽标、段评、作者语(角色对话保留)
3. 正文插图已保留; 文字嵌入模式下头像按文字行高显示(较小)

■ MD3版本注意事项
1. 若换书后图片样式未生效: 从书架删除该书重新加入
2. 首次打开较长的书, 目录页(全量章节)加载略慢属正常
3. 图片排版受Legado MD3文本阅读器限制: 图片只能「小尺寸内联同行」或「大尺寸独占一行」, 无法像原网站聊天气泡那样左右分栏

    var t = talks.get(i);

    var av = t.select('.avatar img').first();
    if (av) avatarSrc = av.attr('src');
    var nm = t.select('.name').first();
    var name = nm ? nm.text() : '';
    var msg = t.select('.talkcontent p').text();
    var p = doc.createElement('p');
    if (avatarSrc) {
      var img = doc.createElement('img');
      img.attr('src', avatarSrc);
      p.appendChild(img);
    }
    p.appendText(name + '：' + msg);
    t.replaceWith(p);
  }
  result = cs.html();
}
result;

五八书阁（m.5859ycdh.com）
免费小说阅读网站，无需登录，无搜索次数限制。

【技术实现】
搜索：POST /search/（body: q={{key}}），不支持分页
发现：分类目录（/wuba131/~139/）+ 书库 + 排行榜 + 完本
  - 分类/书库/排行榜支持 ?page={{page}} 分页
  - 完本不支持分页（固定100本）
详情：/wuba/{bookId}/ CSS 选择器
目录：/wuba/{bookId}/list.html（全量章节，无分页）
正文：/wubashu/{bookId}/{chapterId}.html（章节内分页，#PageSet）

【URL 规律】
书籍详情：/wuba/{bookId}/
章节目录：/wuba/{bookId}/list.html
正文页面：/wubashu/{bookId}/{chapterId}.html
正文分页：{chapterId}-{pageNum}.html

【规则语法说明】
- 详情页：用 Default规则语法(class.B@tag.dd.1@...) 和 CSS类选择器(span.ml, span.c)
- 发现/搜索页：用 Default规则语法(tag.dd.1@...)，因为CSS选择器不支持数字索引
- 发现页 dl.B（大卡片）和 dl.S（小卡片）共存，bookList 用逗号合并
- 部分页面图片使用 data-src 懒加载，已用 || 兼容
- 正文末尾有广告文本，已用正则清理
- 正文有内分页，已配置 nextContentUrl
- 编码：UTF-8

【技术实现】
搜索：HTML 搜索（GET /search.php?q=）
发现：CSS 选择器（library.php 分页）
详情：CSS 选择器（详情页与目录同页）
目录：CSS 选择器（chapter-chip）
正文：CSS@html + JS 解码，反爬字符自动还原
登录：POST 表单登录（loginUi + loginUrl，Cookie 持久化）
【局限性】
- 网站有 GOEDGE WAF 防护，必须使用移动端 UA 请求头
- 章节以"段"为单位（TXT 分段），非传统章节
- 列表页作者字段实为上传者昵称
- 作者规则 v4：作者只存在于正文预览文本/书名，五级兜底（行首「作者 X」全行扫描 > 预览行内「书名 作者：X」 > 书名内嵌 > 书名by作者 > 整页兜底），自动截断后缀、屏蔽免责话术，源站无作者则留空
- 登录需在书源设置中配置邮箱和密码（切勿在公开群组分享含账号的书源）

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let data=JSON.parse(result).data
let chapterList=[]
for(var volume of data){
	chapterList.push({
		name:volume.volume_name,
		isVolume:true,
		info:volume.volume_desc
		})
		for(var chapter of volume.chapter_list){
			var isVip=chapter.chapter_ispay==0?"":"💰"
			var time=java.timeFormat(chapter.chapter_time*1000)
			chapterList.push({
				name:isVip+chapter.chapter_name,
				isVolume:false,
				info:`更新时间:`+time+` 字数:${chapter.chapter_number}`,
				url:`/api/readWithEncrypt?chapter_id=${chapter.chapter_id}&nid=${chapter.chapter_nid}&preload=0`
				})
			}
	}
chapterList
</js>

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var html=(typeof result==='string')?result:String(result.html());var doc=Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);var ps=doc.select('#htmlContent p');if(ps.size()==0){ps=doc.select('.panel-readcontent p');}var out=[];for(var i=0;i<ps.size();i++){var t=String(ps.get(i).text()).trim();if(!t)continue;if(t.indexOf('提醒您')>-1&&(t.indexOf('最新章节')>-1||t.indexOf('金银')>-1||t.indexOf('修复')>-1))continue;if(t.indexOf('域名')>-1&&(t.indexOf('记住')>-1||t.indexOf('牢记')>-1||t.indexOf('金银')>-1))continue;if(t.indexOf('金银小说')>-1&&(t.indexOf('首发')>-1||t.indexOf('无弹窗')>-1||t.indexOf('完整章节')>-1))continue;if(t.indexOf('如章节缺失')>-1||t.indexOf('#阅#读#模#式')>-1||t.indexOf('你看#到的')>-1)continue;if(t.indexOf('☧')>-1||t.indexOf('ˍ')>-1||t.indexOf('⊞')>-1)continue;if(t.indexOf('推荐他的其他作品')>-1||t.indexOf('记住域名')>-1||t.indexOf('全网首发无弹窗')>-1)continue;if(t.indexOf('网址：/book/')>-1)continue;if(t.indexOf('讨论本书')>-1)continue;if(t.indexOf('听说')===0&&(t.indexOf('本书')>-1||t.indexOf('恋人')>-1||t.indexOf('运气')>-1||t.indexOf('幸运')>-1))continue;if(t.indexOf('(请来')>-1&&t.indexOf('完整章节')>-1)continue;if(t.indexOf('（请来')>-1&&t.indexOf('完整章节')>-1)continue;out.push(t);}return out.join('\n');})()

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
  let defaultVariable = {
    "volume": {
      "status": false,
      "mode": 1,
      "spacer": " | ",
      "emptyVolumeName": {
        "action": false,
        "replace": "第一卷：默认"
      },
      "onlyOneShow": false
    }
  }
  let variable = (book.getVariable("custom") != "" && book.getVariable("custom") != null) ? book.getVariable("custom") : source.getVariable();
  if(variable != "" && variable != null){
    try{
      variable = JSON.parse(variable);
    } catch(err) {
      java.log(err);
      variable = defaultVariable;
    }
  } else {
    variable = defaultVariable;
  }
  let data = JSON.parse(result).data;
  let list = data.chapterListWithVolume;
  let volume = data.volumeNameList;
  let chapters = [];
  let volume_names = [];
  for(let i in list){
    for(let x in list[i]){
      let c = list[i][x];
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 1 && volume_names.indexOf(c.volume_name) == -1){
        volume_names.push(c.volume_name);
        if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          chapters.push({
            title: ((c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace) ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name),
            isVolume: true
          });
        }
      }
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 2){
        if(c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace){
          c.title = (c.volume_name == "" ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name) + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        } else if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          c.title = c.volume_name + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        }
      }
      c.url  = `https://fanqienovel.com/reader/${c.itemId}?enter_from=page&force_mobile=0`;
      chapters.push(c);
    }
  }
  chapters
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
d=/"text": "(.*)",/.test(result)?String(result).match(/ "text": "(.*)",/)[1]:"暂无目录";
b=d.replace(/<.*?>/g,"").replace(/#.*?#/g,"");
c=baseUrl;
l=[];

if(/网页链接/.test(d) || /timeline_card_small_article_default/.test(d)){
	if(/timeline_card_small_article_default/.test(d)){
		l=[{text:b.substring(0,10)+"......",href:c}]
	l.push({
		href:result.match(/"page_url": "([^"]+)",/)[1]+",{'webView':true}",
		text:result.match(/"content1": "([^"]+)",/)[1],
		info:result.match(/ "content2": "([^"]+)",/)[1]
		})
}

if(/网页链接/.test(d)){
	list = d.match(/<br \/>[^<]+<a  href=\\"[^"]+\\" data-hid/g);
	l.push({
		text:b.substring(0,10)+"......",
		href:c
		})
	for(i in list){
	l.push({
		text : list[i].match(/>([^<]+)<a/)[1],
		href:list[i].match(/href=\\"([^"]+)\\"/)[1]
		})
	  }
	}
	}else{
		l=[{text:b.substring(0,10)+"......",href:c}]
		}
		l
</js>

<js>
var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;

var document = JsDom.parse(src);

function getText(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().text() : "";
}

function getHref(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().attr("href") : "";
}

function getSrc(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().attr("src") : "";
}

function generateJsonList() {
    var jsonList = [];
    var uls = document.select(".mySearch ul").not(".pagination"); 

    uls.forEach(function(ul) {
        var prevDiv = ul.previousElementSibling(); 
        var imgSrc = prevDiv ? getSrc("img", prevDiv) : ""; 

        var item = {
            "img": imgSrc,
            "name": getText("li:eq(0) a.b", ul),
            "author": getText("li:eq(2)", ul),
            "wordcount": getText("li:eq(3)", ul),
            "lastchaptr": getText("li:eq(1) a", ul),
            "kind": getText("li:eq(4)", ul)+","+getText("li:eq(5)", ul),
            "url": getHref("li:eq(0) a.b", ul)
        };
        jsonList.push(item);
    });

    return jsonList;
}

result = generateJsonList();
String(java.log(JSON.stringify(result)));


</js>

                }
            };

【搜索方式】
• 关键词搜索：直接在搜索框输入书名或关键词 
• 标签搜索：在搜索框输入"tag:标签名"或"标签:标签名"（例："tag:玄幻"）
  注：标签搜索只能搜索到打上了相应标签小说，冒号不区分中英文
  有效的搜索："tag:无限流"、"标签：爽文"
  无效的搜索："tag:猫"（没有一个标签包含字样"猫"）
【v2.0 更新说明】
1. 新增标签搜索功能；
2. 发现页拓展，具体新增内容自行查看；
3. 发现页新增"我的书架"入口，该书架与网页端菠萝猫书架直接同步；
【v2.1 更新说明】
1. 关键词搜索改用 rrssk 站点入口（网站合作更新）；
2. 通过Java方法提交搜索，需登录（若不登录，搜索有概率跳转到可乐小说）；
3. 无搜索次数限制；
【v2.2 更新说明】
1. 提交搜索改为适应当前网页算法，需登录；
【注】
反馈Bug以及书源获取添加QQ群：1040259688，如果网站有算法或加密更新，后续书源可能不再公开发布
与rrssk相关的书源如可乐小说等，亦可通过相似方法获取，不过不建议混用书源，书库内容是一样的

<js>
(function() {
    // 1. 判断是否是标签搜索
    function isTagSearch(key) {
        return /^(tag|标签)[:：]/.test(key);
    }
  
    if (isTagSearch(key)) {
        java.longToast('🔍 正在使用标签搜索（菠萝猫搜索）');
        var tag = key.replace(/^(tag|标签)[:：]/, '').trim();
        var baseUrl = 'https://www.boluomao.com/tag/' + java.encodeURI(tag) + '/';
        return page > 1 ? baseUrl + 'page/' + page + '/' : baseUrl;
    }

    // 2. 关键词搜索逻辑 (通过缓存和 rrssk.com 动态签名)
    var cacheKey = "rrssk_find_url_" + java.md5Encode(key);
    var targetUrl = cache.get(cacheKey);

    if (!targetUrl) {
        java.longToast('🔍 正在安全连接并检索书籍...');
        var window = {};
      
        // 获取中转页 HTML
        var resHtml = java.get('https://www.rrssk.com/boluomao.html', {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            "Referer": "https://www.rrssk.com/"
        }).body();

        // 提取 _t
        var tMatch = resHtml.match(/name="_t"\s+value="([^"]+)"/);
        if (!tMatch) {
            throw new Error("无法从中转页获取到签名令牌(_t)");
        }
        var tVal = tMatch[1];

        // 依次执行所有内联 script，加载签名函数及可能用到的加密工具函数
        var scriptRegex = /<script[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi;
        var match;
        var foundSign = false;
        while ((match = scriptRegex.exec(resHtml)) !== null) {
            var code = match[1];
            if (code && code.trim().length > 0) {
                try {
                    eval(code);
                    if (code.indexOf("__SIGN") !== -1) {
                        foundSign = true;
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    // 忽略部分因缺少浏览器DOM环境引起的无害报错
                }
            }
        }

        if (!foundSign || !window.__SIGN || typeof window.__SIGN.f !== 'function') {
            throw new Error("未能成功初始化动态签名算法，请反馈至作者维护");
        }

        // 与 PHP rawurlencode 完全一致的 RFC3986 编码
        function __enc(x) {
            return encodeURIComponent(x).replace(/[!'()*]/g, function(c) {
                return '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase();
            });
        }

        var ts = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
        var s = window.__SIGN.f(__enc(key), tVal, ts);

        // 构造载荷提交 POST 搜索请求
        var postData = "action=search&_t=" + tVal + "&_ts=" + ts + "&_s=" + s + "&keyword=" + java.encodeURI(key);
        var postRes = java.post("https://www.rrssk.com/?action=search", postData, {
            "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
            "Referer": "https://www.rrssk.com/boluomao.html",

63书阁(m.63sg.com) 书源
规则版本: 2026-09-05
【站点结构】
  详情页 /novel/{id}/  目录页 /dir/{id}/?page=N&sort=asc(每页50章)
  正文页 /read/{id}/{卷}/{章}.html  章内分页 /read/{id}/{卷}/{章}/{页}.html
  搜索 POST /so.html (searchtype=novelname&searchkey=关键词)
  分类 /type/{分类}_0_{状态}_{排序}_{页码}.html (页码用下划线连接)
【书源URL正则】bookUrlPattern 同时匹配 m. 与 www. 两个子域
【UA】header 字段已固定移动端 User-Agent(站点按 UA 下发移动模板)
【⚠️重要限制：站点付费墙】
  本站每本书仅前约65章免费，其后章节服务端返回占位文字
  『请登录后在继续阅读本部小说！』。已实测：注册并登录后该限制依旧存在，
  加书架也无效，属于站点付费墙而非登录问题。
  本源的正文规则会把该占位文字替换为明确的付费章节提示。
  完本小说/短篇(章节数少于免费额度)可完整阅读。
【搜索频率】站点限制搜索间隔，请勿频繁搜索。
【技术说明】
  1) 列表(搜索/发现)字段用 @js: 直取 jsoup。原因：实测发现 Legado 的
     AnalyzeByJSoup 在同一元素上连续解析多条 CSS 规则时存在 Elements 状态污染，
     会使靠后的 bookUrl/kind 规则返回空并回退成列表页地址(表现为整页只出1本书)。
     改用 @js: 走 JS 通道可完全规避，且带 a.cover 兜底。
  2) 站点按固定字数硬切分页，会把   实体切成两半(如 &nb / sp; 、&n / bsp;)，
     且孤立 & 会被 jsoup 转义成 &。content 规则内联
     ##&(?:amp;)?n(?:b(?:s(?:p;?)?)?)?|nbsp;?|sp;|(?<=>)(?:p;|;|bsp;)|&(?![a-zA-Z#])|&(?![a-zA-Z#])##
     统一清除各类碎片与冗余缩进实体，同时保留 &B / { 等正常写法。
  3) chapterList 用 @js: 过滤站点脏数据：个别书的目录里混有 /0.html 这类不存在的章节
     (访问会 302 回详情页导致内容为空)；intro 用 @js: 对半去重，修复部分书 og:description
     被站点自身写重复两遍的问题。
  4) nextContentUrl 用 #next_url 定位，并用正则把三段式(下一章)清空，只保留四段式(章内下一页)。

function qmVideoState(kind) {

  try {

    var state = saved ? JSON.parse(String(saved)) : null
    if (state && state.pages) return state
  } catch (e) {}
  return {pages:{}}
}

function qmResetVideoState(kind) {

function qmVideoUploadIds(kind, page) {
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  if (page == '1') {
    qmResetVideoState.call(this, kind)
    return []
  }
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var ids = []
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b) }).forEach(function (key) {
    if (Number(key) < Number(page)) ids = ids.concat(state.pages[key] || [])
  })
  var seen = {}
  return ids.filter(function (id) { id = String(id); if (!id || seen[id]) return false; seen[id] = 1; return true }).slice(-120).map(function (id) {
    return {id:String(id),item_type:kind == 'animated' ? '14' : '11',ts:String(Date.now()),type:'0'}
  })
}

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered
}

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {
  var ctx = this
  if (node == null || depth > 8) return
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    node.forEach(function (item) { qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, item, mode, output, seen, depth + 1) })
    return
  }
  if (typeof node != 'object') return
  var itemMode = mode == 'publish' ? 'novel' : mode
  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {
    var key = mode + '-' + id
    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = 1
      output.push(qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, node, itemMode, mode))
    }
  }
  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!/^(meta|stat_params|track_id|tag_items|category_list|rank_list)$/.test(key)) {
      qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, node[key], mode, output, seen, depth + 1)
    }
  })
}

function qmDateText(value) {
  var seconds = Number(value || 0)
  if (!seconds) return ''
  var date = new Date(seconds > 9999999999 ? seconds : seconds * 1000)

  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + two(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + two(date.getDate()) + ' ' + two(date.getHours()) + ':' + two(date.getMinutes())
}

function qmNovelInfo(raw) {
  raw = raw || {}
  var info = {}
  Object.keys(raw).forEach(function (key) { info[key] = raw[key] })
  var tags = (raw.book_tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return String(x.title || '') }).filter(function (x) { return !!x })
  var attribute = raw.attribute || {}
  var extras = attribute.extra_info_list || []
  function findExtra(pattern) {
    for (var i = 0; i < extras.length; i++) {
      if (pattern.test(String(extras[i].sub_title || extras[i].title || ''))) return qmExtraInfoText(extras[i])
    }
    return ''
  }
  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)
  if (score && String(score).indexOf('分') < 0) score = String(score) + '分'
  var reading = ''
  var readingList = attribute.reading_info_list || []
  if (readingList.length > 2) reading = qmExtraInfoText(readingList[2]) || String(readingList[2].title || readingList[2].text || '')
  if (!reading) reading = findExtra(/正在阅读|在线/)
  var lines = []
  var updated = qmDateText(raw.update_time)
  if (updated) lines.push('🧭 更新：' + updated)
  if (raw.category_over_words) lines.push('📒 关于：' + raw.category_over_words)
  if (score) lines.push('💯 分数：' + score)
  if (reading) lines.push('👁️ 在线：' + reading)
  if (tags.length) lines.push('🏷️ 标签：' + tags.join(' / '))
  if (raw.characters) lines.push('👥 角色：' + raw.characters)
  if (raw.publisher) lines.push('🏢 出版：' + raw.publisher)
  if (raw.isbn) lines.push('🔖 ISBN：' + raw.isbn)
  var copyright = raw.statement || raw.source_name
  if (copyright) lines.push('📍 版权来源：' + copyright)
  if (raw.intro) lines.push('📄 简介：' + raw.intro)
  info.id = String(raw.id || '')
  info.author = raw.author || raw.author_name || ''
  info.image_link = raw.big_image_link || raw.image_link || raw.thumb_image_link || ''
  info.intro = lines.join('\n')
  info.kind = [raw.category_over_words].concat(tags).filter(function (x) { return !!x }).join(',')
  info.last_chapter = raw.latest_chapter_title || raw.chapter_list_desc || ''
  info.words_num = raw.words_num || raw.word_count || ''
  return info
}

}

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {
    input = input || {}
    var ctx = this
    var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
    var kind = String(input.kind || 'paragraph')
    var cursor = String(input.cursor || '')
    var response
    var data
    var list = []
    var tags = []
    var total = ''
    var next = ''
    if (kind == 'book') {
      var bookId = String(input.bookId || '')
      var bookHot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1'
      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}
      if (cursor) bp.next_id = cursor

      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')
      tags = (evaluateInfo.tag_list || data.tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return {id:String(x.id || x.tag_id || '1'),title:String(x.title || x.name || '全部'),count:String(x.count || x.comment_count || '')} })
    } else {
      var hot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1' ? '1' : '0'
      var params = {book_id:String(input.bookId || ''),chapter_id:String(input.chapterId || '')}
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor
        response = qmGet.call(ctx, moreUrl, params)
      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'
        if (kind == 'chapter') params.extra = ''
        response = qmPostForm.call(ctx, firstUrl, params)
      }
      data = response.data || {}
      if (cursor) {
        list = (data.comment_list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) })
        next = String(data.next_id || '')
      } else {
        var hotZone = data.hot_zone || {}

        var hotList = hotZone.comment_list || []
        var timeList = timeZone.comment_list || []

function qmOpenComment(kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId) {
  var html = qmCommentHtml.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId)
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'showBrowser')) return false
  runtimeJava.showBrowser('https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/', html, 'window.java=java;window.cache=cache;window.source=source;window.qmRun=run;window.qmLocalCommentPage=true;', JSON.stringify({state:4,isHideable:true,heightPercentage:cfg.height,widthPercentage:1.0,dismissOnTouchOutside:true,skipCollapsed:true,expandedCornersRadius:16,isGestureInsetBottomIgnored:true,hardwareAccelerated:true,webViewInitialScale:100}))
  return true
}

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var normalizedKind = String(kind || '')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var color = cfg.color
  count = Number(count || 0)
  if (count <= 0) return ''
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph' && cfg.split) color = hot ? cfg.hotColor : count >= cfg.splitCount ? cfg.splitColor : cfg.color
  count = Math.min(count, 999)
  var svg
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph') {
    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :
      '<svg viewBox="5 14 45 36" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="180" height="144"><path d="M44 48 Q48 48 48 44 L48 20 Q48 16 44 16 L20 16 Q16 16 16 20 L16 24 S16 28 10 30 Q6 32 10 34 Q16 36 16 38 L16 44 Q16 48 20 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.7"/><text x="32" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="' + color + '" dominant-baseline="middle">' + displayText + '</text></svg>'
  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="6" y="6" width="988" height="116" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="3"/><text x="48" y="79" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="' + color + '">' + qmEsc(label) + '</text><text x="950" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="34" fill="' + color + '">' + count + ' 条 ›</text></svg>'
  } else {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="150" y="150" width="665" height="525" rx="175" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="18"/><text x="480" y="535" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="middle" font-size="298" fill="' + color + '">' + count + '</text></svg>'
  }
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + [normalizedKind, bid, cid, pid, label || '', checkId || ''].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var style = normalizedKind == 'paragraph' ? qmCommentConfig.call(this).svgSize : 'FULL'
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:style,type:'qmpl',click:call})
}

function qmBubbleImage(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var data = qmSvg.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot)
  return data ? '<img src="' + data + '">' : ''
}

function qmGodImage(bid, cid, pid, gid, text) {
  text = String(text || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim()
  if (!gid || !text) return ''
  if (text.length > 18) text = text.slice(0, 18) + '...'
  var svg = '<svg width="1000" height="120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' +
    '<rect x="2" y="0" width="996" height="100" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" rx="35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>' +
    '<rect x="32" y="22" width="140" height="56" rx="20" fill="#FF4444"/>' +
    '<text x="102" y="64" font-size="32" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">神评</text>' +
    '<text x="196" y="64" font-size="38" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">' + qmEsc(text) + '</text></svg>'
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + ['paragraph', bid, cid, pid, '七猫神评', gid].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var data = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:'FULL',type:'qmpl-god',click:call})
  return '<img src="' + data + '">'
}

function qmChapterReviewCount(bid, cid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-chapter-' + bid + '-' + cid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/comment/chapter-end-comment', {book_id:bid,chapter_ids:cid}).data || {}
  var comments = data.comments || []
  var count = comments.length ? Number(comments[0].count || 0) : 0
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmBookReviewCount(bid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-book-' + bid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', {circle_id:bid,need_common:'0',tag_id:'1',book_id:bid,sort:'0'}).data || {}
  var count = Number(data.evaluates_info && data.evaluates_info.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || 0)
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmContentTitle(value, baseUrl) {
  var text = String(value || '')
  var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
  try { if (runtimeChapter) runtimeChapter.putImgUrl(null) } catch (e) {}
  return text
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

bookSourceComment:
格格党网（www.ggd66.com 思思CMS·UTF-8）2026-09-09 重构 【原站已失效】旧域名 www.ggd8.cc/m TLS 握手被重置（手机侧与本机均不可达），已迁移至同源镜像 www.ggd66.com 1.搜索：GET /search/?searchkey=关键词（表单 POST 同用），单页返回 25~100 条、无分页控件 2.【限频对策】站点搜索限30秒/次，实现方式=下发 Cookie ss_search_delay 标记，服务端只查标记不校验时间戳 → searchUrl 每次搜索前剔除该 Cookie 键（其余键原样保留）即可无等待连续搜索，已实测连搜4次全放行 3.详情：og:novel:* meta 齐全；简介取 .bookintro 截断到
（去掉站点宣传语） 4.目录：详情页 #list-chapterAll 内 dd>a 全量内联无分页（实测最多 5951 章完整），dl 首个区是“最新章节”倒序已避开；按章节ID自动判序 5.正文：#rtext 内逐段清洗——命中广告词时从该词处【截断】而非整段删除（站点常把广告拼在正文句尾，整删会误伤正文）；乱码域名按半角问号密集(占比>1/3)+域名/www./.vip 短行识别；全角？？？与【…】剧情内容不受影响 6.章内分页：{章节ID}_{N}.html，nextContentUrl 只跟带下划线的链接；末页“下一页”指向下一章(无下划线)→返回空自然终止，杜绝串章 7.发现：22 个入口=首页4榜(?tab=1~4 分发)+8分类+8完本分类+全部+全本大厅；列表解析器一次适配 bookbox/item/li/最近更新 四种模板 8.【无需登录】全部正文匿名免费可读；登录UI为可选功能(永久书架同步)，站点登录无验证码，判据=GET /bookcase/ 含“永久书架” 注意：登录成功后不写 putLoginHeader，避免把限频 Cookie 固化进登录头拖累搜索 9.bookUrlPattern=…/qu/[0-9]+/? 便于浏览器打开书籍页时一键导入 10.列表/详情/目录/正文规则全用 @js:+jsoup 直取，实体统一交 jsoup Parser.unescapeEntities 解码（String.replace 只换首个的坑已避） 使用前建议：书架里指向 ggd8.cc 的旧书需重新搜索添加

<js>
var m = result.match(/qsbs\.bb\('([A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)'\)/g);
var out = [];
if (m) {
  for (var i = 0; i < m.length; i++) {
    var d = String(java.base64Decode(m[i].match(/'([^']+)'/)[1]));
    if (d.indexOf('<p') != 0) continue;
    var t = d.replace(/<\/?p[^>]*>/g, '');
    t = t.replace(/[-－]{0,3}>{0,3}\s*少年小说网（www\.snxsw\.com）[^！\n]{0,20}！/g, '');
    t = t.replace(/\s*-{1,3}>*\s*$/, '');
    if (!t) continue;
    if (/^第[0-9零一二两三四五六七八九十百千万]+章.{0,15}$/.test(t) && !/[。！？…”"]$/.test(t)) continue;
    out.push(t);
  }
}
out.join('\n')
</js>

	list.push({text:text,href:href})

//md5加密开始
var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}
var F = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & y) | ((~x) & z)
}
var G = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & z) | (y & (~z))
}
var H = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x ^ y ^ z)
}
var I = function(x, y, z) {
    return (y ^ (x | (~z)))
}
var FF = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(F(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var GG = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(G(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var HH = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(H(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var II = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(I(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var convertToWordArray = function(string) {
    var lWordCount;
    var lMessageLength = string.length;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempOne = lMessageLength + 8;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempTwo = (lNumberOfWordsTempOne - (lNumberOfWordsTempOne % 64)) / 64;
    var lNumberOfWords = (lNumberOfWordsTempTwo + 1) * 16;
    var lWordArray = Array(lNumberOfWords - 1);
    var lBytePosition = 0;
    var lByteCount = 0;
    while (lByteCount < lMessageLength) {
        lWordCount = (lByteCount - (lByteCount % 4)) / 4;
        lBytePosition = (lByteCount % 4) * 8;
        lWordArray[lWordCount] = (lWordArray[lWordCount] | (string.charCodeAt(lByteCount) << lBytePosition));
        lByteCount++
    }
    lWordCount = (lByteCount - (lByteCount % 4)) / 4;
    lBytePosition = (lByteCount % 4) * 8;
    lWordArray[lWordCount] = lWordArray[lWordCount] | (0x80 << lBytePosition);
    lWordArray[lNumberOfWords - 2] = lMessageLength << 3;
    lWordArray[lNumberOfWords - 1] = lMessageLength >>> 29;
    return lWordArray
};
var wordToHex = function(lValue) {
    var WordToHexValue = "",
    WordToHexValueTemp = "",
    lByte, lCount;
    for (lCount = 0; lCount <= 3; lCount++) {
        lByte = (lValue >>> (lCount * 8)) & 255;
        WordToHexValueTemp = "0" + lByte.toString(16);
        WordToHexValue = WordToHexValue + WordToHexValueTemp.substr(WordToHexValueTemp.length - 2, 2)
    }
    return WordToHexValue

var html = String(result);
var doc = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var content = doc.selectFirst('div.TxtContent');
var lines = [];
if (content) {
    var ps = content.select('p');
    for (var i = 0; i < ps.size(); i++) {
        var t = String(ps.get(i).text()).replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (t && !/温馨提示|本章.*完.*继续阅读|wjzxchina/.test(t)) {
            lines.push(t);
        }
    }
    if (lines.length === 0) {
        var text = String(content.text()).replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (text) lines.push(text);
    }
}

bookSourceComment:
本书源难点：目录详情页60章，目录页61开始。正文加密。
【技术实现】
搜索：POST搜索（/search.html，body: s={{key}}），搜索前去cookie防间隔限制
发现：CSS选择器（分类页 .outdiv 卡片）
详情：og:novel 元数据
目录：详情页获取前60章 + nextTocUrl跳转至TOC页 + JS从select下拉菜单获取所有分页（跳过首项避免重复）
正文：webview加载（JS自动执行qsbs.bb Base64解码写入#article）+ java.ajax提取next_url

【目录流程】
1. 详情页：chapterList JS提取最后一个info-chapters div（前60章），nextTocUrl通过"查看更多章节"按钮跳转至TOC页
2. TOC页：chapterList JS从select下拉菜单获取所有分页URL，跳过第一项（详情页URL，避免与前60章重复），逐页ajax获取剩余章节
3. TOC页无"查看更多章节"文本，nextTocUrl返回空，自动停止

【正文流程】
- 正文通过document.writeln(qsbs.bb('Base64'))动态加载，需webview执行JS
- 章节分页：第1页URL:/book/ID/章节ID.html，第2页:/book/ID/章节ID/1.html，用/book/数字/数字/数字.html区分
- next_url在#article外的.read_nav中，用java.ajax单独获取

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
var list = [];
var base = source.getKey();

function toAbs(url) {
    if (url && url.indexOf('http') != 0) {
        return base + (url.indexOf('/') == 0 ? url : '/' + url);
    }
    return url;
}

var select = document.select('select option');
var urls = [];
for (var i = 0; i < select.size(); i++) {
    var url = select.get(i).attr('value');
    if (url) urls.push(toAbs(url));
}

if (urls.length == 0) {
    var divs = document.select('div.info-chapters.flex.flex-wrap');
    if (divs.size() > 0) {
        var last = divs.last();
        var links = last.select('a[href*=.html]');
        for (var i = 0; i < links.size(); i++) {
            list.push({text: links.get(i).text(), url: links.get(i).attr('href')});
        }
    }
}

for (var p = 1; p < urls.length; p++) {
    var html = String(java.ajax(urls[p]));
    var doc = JsDom.parse(html);
    var divs = doc.select('div.info-chapters.flex.flex-wrap');
    if (divs.size() > 0) {
        var last = divs.last();
        var links = last.select('a[href*=.html]');
        for (var j = 0; j < links.size(); j++) {
            var t = links.get(j).text();
            if (t && t.indexOf('开始阅读') == -1 && t.indexOf('小说详情') == -1) {
                list.push({text: t, url: links.get(j).attr('href')});
            }
        }
    }
}
list;
</js>

     var href = lis[i].select('a').attr('href');
     var text = lis[i].text();
     if (href==0) {
        if ( i < lis.length - 1 ) {
            var url = "https://www.baidu.com/" + id + lis[i + 1].select('a').attr('href');         
        } else {
            var url = "https://cn.bing.com/" + id + lis[i - 1].select('a').attr('href');
        }
     } else { var url = base + href; }
     java.log(lis[i].text()+":"+url);
     list.push({"text": text, "href": url});
}

list

bookSourceComment:
owllook开源小说搜索引擎聚合书源

v16 根本性优化发现加载速度：
问题: v15在bookUrl中用java.ajax()搜索，Legado显示发现列表时对每本书
      都执行ajax(1.5s/本)，80本书=120秒
修复: bookUrl只编码中文参数(瞬时)，不做ajax搜索
      改用ruleBookInfo.tocUrl在用户点击后才搜索提取详情页链接

流程对比:
  v15: 发现页→80本书各ajax搜索(120s)→显示列表
  v16: 发现页→编码URL(瞬时)→显示列表→点击→访问搜索页→提取详情页→目录
  v16.1:搜索增加cookie.removeCookie

v14修复（已保留）：
- content: @js:遍历选择器(#txt→#htmlContent→#content→#booktxt→.show-content)
- chapterUrl: 纯URL逻辑(不依赖#content_url)
- chapterList: CSS逗号兼容6种源站结构
全程零WebView

<js>
var bes = result.match(/PHA\+[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+={0,2}/g);
//java.log(String(bes))
if (!bes) {
    var ml = java.webView(null,baseUrl,null);
    var txt = java.getString("#txt@html");
    java.longToast("正文解密失败，转为webView动态加载。");
} else {
var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {
    // 遍历数组，使用阅读内置Base64解码方法
    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);
    var txtt = String(bsej);
    result.push(txtt);
      }
var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>var m = String(baseUrl).match(/\/books\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html/);
if (!m) {
    result = '章节地址解析失败: ' + baseUrl;
} else {
    var aid = m[1];
    var cid = m[2];
    var ua = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36';
    var opt = ',{"headers":{"User-Agent":"' + ua + '","Referer":"' + baseUrl + '","X-Requested-With":"XMLHttpRequest"}}';
    var tokenJs = String(java.ajax('https://www.deqixs.cc/scripts/chapter.js.php?aid=' + aid + '&cid=' + cid + '&referrer=' + baseUrl + opt) || '');
    var t = tokenJs.match(/chapterToken\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/);
    var s = tokenJs.match(/timestamp\s*=\s*([0-9]+)/);
    var n = tokenJs.match(/nonce\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/);
    if (!t || !s || !n) {
        result = '获取token失败，请重试';
    } else {
        var apiUrl = 'https://www.deqixs.cc/modules/article/ajax2.php?aid=' + aid + '&cid=' + cid + '&token=' + t[1] + '&timestamp=' + s[1] + '&nonce=' + n[1] + opt;
        var res = String(java.ajax(apiUrl) || '');
        var json = null;
        try { json = JSON.parse(res); } catch (e) {}
        if (json && json.status == 1 && json.data && json.data.content) {
            result = json.data.content.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n').replace(/ /gi, ' ').replace(/更新不易[\s\S]*?(看最新章节|看最新无错章节|最新小说章节|请订阅)[！!]/g, '').replace(/速\s*读\s*谷|shudugu\.org/g, '').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
        } else {
            result = '获取正文失败: ' + (json && json.message ? json.message : res.substring(0, 100));
        }
    }
}</js>
